method_working_name: PIC-DTA: Paired Interval-Censored Counterfactual Drug-Target Affinity
purpose: construct immutable drug and WT-to-modified protein features for a later paired potential-outcome model without opening affinity labels

novelty_boundary.candidate_contribution_to_test_later: a drug-conditioned WT-versus-modified potential-outcome effect distribution supervised jointly by exact deltas and mathematically valid one-sided delta intervals induced by paired assay censoring
novelty_boundary.claim_gate: no core algorithm innovation claim unless the frozen full model beats mutation-identity shuffle, no-drug-conditioning, point-label-only, WT-echo, and direct-affinity controls under grouped out-of-fold evaluation

pair_mapping.mapping_rule: a modified identifier is paired to the unique listed base protein whose identifier plus underscore is its prefix
pair_mapping.unpaired_rule: retain in feature manifest but exclude from paired-effect Phase A
pair_mapping.phosphorylation_rule: suffix/state p is an explicit binary feature even when amino-acid sequences are identical

alignment.sequence_scope: official full construct sequence, so mutations outside the UniProt kinase-domain annotation remain visible
alignment.hard_stop: every non-phosphorylation-only modified construct must yield at least one changed block

context.wt_and_modified_windows: separate aligned local windows centered on each changed block
context.same_sequence_phosphorylation: exact zero ESM2 delta with explicit phosphorylation token

saved_vectors: mean WT local-window embedding across changed blocks
mean modified local-window embedding across changed blocks
protein_representation.precision: CUDA autocast float16 with float32 saved outputs

required_audits: no forbidden label file or label column opened
exact construct, ligand, modification, pairing and phosphorylation-group counts
alignment reconstruction equals each original WT and modified sequence
nonzero ESM2 delta for every sequence-changing modified construct
exact-zero ESM2 delta for same-sequence phosphorylation-only construct
hard_stops: abort on any hash or frozen count mismatch
never read DAVIS affinity labels during feature extraction
never infer phosphorylation from amino-acid sequence alone
never use the unpaired GCN2 construct as a paired delta observation
never alter the immutable 888/480/24/384 target scope
never call label-blind features a validated model or algorithm innovation
